heading: Bringing Experience Home
text: After nearly 20 years serving inside the Orange County Clerk’s Office, Terrell took his experience beyond Orange County, working with courts and justice organizations on technology and modernization. Now, he’s ready to put that experience to work for the community he calls home. .

heading: People First
text: Our people are our greatest strength. We will invest in employees, develop leaders, and foster a culture that empowers every team member to deliver exceptional public service. By creating an environment built on respect, accountability, collaboration, and professional growth, we will strengthen the workforce that serves Orange County every day.

heading: Community Focused
text: The Clerk's Office should be more than a place people visit- it should be an active partner throughout Orange County. We will expand outreach, strengthen partnerships, improve accessibility, and ensure residents can easily connect with the services they need. By listening first, we will build lasting public trust through transparency and engagement.

heading: Future Ready
text: Preparing for tomorrow requires thoughtful leadership and responsible stewardship. We will embrace modern technology, cybersecurity, continuous improvement, and fiscal responsibility while maximizing existing investments. Together, these efforts will build a Clerk's Office that is innovative, accountable, and prepared for the future.

heading: The Experience Behind Clerk Forward
text: Terrell Thomas has built a career around public service, court technology, and helping organizations work better for the people they serve. His journey began with the Orange County Clerk of Courts in 1998, where he spent nearly 20 years gaining firsthand experience with the people, operations, technology, and justice partners that keep one of Florida's busiest court systems moving.

heading: The Experience Behind Clerk Forward
text: He later brought that experience to the private sector, helping courts and justice agencies across the country modernize operations through innovative technology solutions. Most recently, Terrell served with Tyler Technologies , the court technology company behind the case management system that powers the Orange County Clerk of Courts today. His work with Tyler gave him a unique perspective - combining nearly two decades of experience inside the Clerk's Office with firsthand experience helping courts implement and maximize the technology that supports their operations.

heading: The Experience Behind Clerk Forward
text: Throughout his career, Terrell has remained committed to a simple leadership philosophy: listen first, bring people together, continuously improve, and use technology thoughtfully to make government work better for the people it serves.

heading: The Experience Behind Clerk Forward
text: A husband, father, longtime minister and church musician, technology consultant, and Orlando community member, Terrell's leadership is grounded in faith, family, integrity, humility, and service.

heading: The Experience Behind Clerk Forward
text: Now, he's ready to bring nearly three decades of experience home to Orange County -combining institutional knowledge, court technology expertise, and a vision that honors the Clerk's proud legacy while preparing the office for what's next.

heading: From Clerk to Candidate
text: My public service journey began with the Orange County Clerk of Courts in 1998. Over nearly 20 years, I gained firsthand experience supporting one of Florida's busiest Clerk's Offices, leading technology initiatives that improved operations and enhanced the delivery of public services.

heading: From Clerk to Candidate
text: Those years gave me a deep appreciation for the important role the Clerk's Office plays in supporting our courts, safeguarding public records, and serving every resident of Orange County.

heading: Faith, Family & Community
text: I am a devoted husband, proud father, and man of faith who believes leadership begins with serving others. I am proud to have spent many years serving local churches throughout Central Florida as a longtime minister and church musician. I am also blessed to serve as an owner of a startup technology consulting and digital transformation company - Dev.G9 Digital.

heading: Faith, Family & Community
text: These experiences have shaped my values of integrity, humility, compassion, and servant leadership-principles that continue to guide both my personal life and professional career.

heading: Award-Winning Leadership
text: My commitment to innovation and collaboration was recognized with the Impact & Innovation Award for developing an organization-wide initiative that transformed information sharing, strengthened employee collaboration, and improved communication across departments.

heading: Award-Winning Leadership
text: For me, innovation has never been about technology alone it's about making government work better for the people who depend on it.

heading: Innovation That Delivers Results
text: Early in my private-sector career, I identified an operational inefficiency and developed a proof of concept that transformed an idea into a scalable solution adopted across the organization. That initiative improved internal operations, enhanced the customer experience, and demonstrated the value of continuous improvement through practical innovation.

heading: Innovation That Delivers Results
text: As my responsibilities expanded, I worked with courts throughout the country to identify trends, solve operational challenges, improve business processes, and strengthen client satisfaction. By listening, collaborating, and focusing on long-term solutions, I helped organizations achieve meaningful improvements while building lasting relationships with the people they serve.

heading: Why I'm Running
text: I believe we can honor the proud legacy of this office while embracing innovation, investing in our employees, strengthening community partnerships, and delivering exceptional service to every resident.
